messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO breach detected for model redwood-xl-int8-v2 in eu-west-1 — streaming p95=820ms (SLO 400ms), p99=5.2s (SLO 1s). Error rate increased 0.7%. Trigger: streaming-tail-latency-detector.

sre_ash: paging oncall @oncall_mai — this looks like a tail spike, multiple streaming stalls reported. Any active deploys?

oncall_mai: I'm on it. No deploys from infra in the last 60m per deploy-bot. Checking model routing & quant profiles.

ml_infra_jules: seeing an uptick in int8 calibration failures across hosts in eu-west-1. Telemetry shows recent auto-calib rollout (profile id=calib-2026-03-12-int8) completed ~30m before alert.

runtime-dev: Confirmed. KV cache miss + dequant errors correlate with higher latencies. Stacktrace snippets from runtime logs: ```ERROR DequantizeFailed: shape mismatch for layer 11```

sre_ash: customer-impact check: support dash shows ~12k streamed requests in last 15m; top affected customer tags: marketplace-app, chat-widget. No full outages but streaming stalls + reconnects.

support_raj: I already opened a ticket with Marketplace SRE — customers reporting “stream freezes ~3-6s then resumes” and some websocket reconnect loops. Severity: S3.

oncall_mai: Initial mitigation plan: 1) pause int8 auto-calib profile rollout 2) pin routing to fp16 variant for high-latency routes 3) reduce batch aggregation window for streaming to 30ms. Doing (1) now.

oncall_mai: `POST /admin/calib/pause` -> 200 OK. Paused calib: calib-2026-03-12-int8.

ml_infra_jules: Good. Rolling back node-level calibration configs too: `kubectl set env ds/quant-agent CALIB_PROFILE=none -n inference` on eu-west-1 replica set. Kicked off.

runtime-dev: Initiating routing change: overlay policy for region eu-west-1 -> prefer model=redwood-xl-fp16-v2 for endpoints with streaming tag. Command: `rroute apply --region eu-west-1 --policy prefer_fp16_streaming --dry-run=false`

incidents-bot: Deploy bot: Canary routing change applied to 10% of traffic at 2867509987; full rollout started at 2867510005.

sre_ash: Observability: after pause & routing change p95 dropped to 470ms within ~90s, p99 now 1.8s (was 5.2s). Still above SLO but improved. Need root cause.

ml_infra_jules: Telemetry dump: quantization calibration logs show elevated NaNs during scale calibration step for specific attention kernels on GPUs with driver 535.24. Kernel mismatch between calibration artifacts and runtime fused-kernels. Likely a timing-sensitive race under production load.

eng_ops_leo: Which hosts? Provide node ids. I see hotspot on worker-nodes: eu-w-rt-12, eu-w-rt-15, eu-w-rt-18. All three recently received driver update 535.24  ~2h ago.

runtime-dev: Seems like the int8 compiled kernels (from calib profile) are incompatible with this driver version under long sequences (>2048 tokens). When KV cache grows, dequant paths hit edge-case leading to expensive fallback and stalls.

oncall_mai: Action items: A) Rollback driver on affected pool to 532.11 B) Demote int8 profile (disable) until repro fixed C) Add perf guard to routing to avoid sending long sequences to int8 variants. I'm coordinating (A) now with infra.

eng_ops_leo: Rolling driver rollback job: `nodepool update-driver --pool inference-euw-prod --version 532.11 --filter node in (eu-w-rt-12,eu-w-rt-15,eu-w-rt-18)`. Start 2867510120. ETA ~6m.

product_emily: Noting customer impact: premium customers on Dedicated may request credits. Emily -> support, please start impact assessment and list affected accounts.

support_raj: Already pulling list. Early subset: marketplace-app-prod, widget-co, travelbot-eu. I'll triage and mark S3 incidents.

ml_infra_jules: Also capturing a reproducible test: run `scripts/repro_quant_stall.sh --model redwood-xl-int8-v2 --seq 4096 --kv-warm` on euw replica reproduces stall ~80% in ~30 runs. Sharing gist: https://stash/internal/gists/quant-stall-28675

runtime-dev: Until we have a fix, recommend: - keep routing preferring fp16 - disable auto-calib globally for int8 - add runtime guard: if seq_len > 2048 route to fp16 - temporary throttle long streaming sessions to reduce KV pressure

incidents-bot: NOTE: Oncall handoff in 45m. Current owner: oncall_mai. Next oncall: sre_ash. Marking for follow-up post-incident review.

sre_ash: Driver rollback finished on nodes listed. Observability now: p95=360ms, p99=980ms, error rate back to baseline. Good recovery.

oncall_mai: Closing immediate paging loop. Logging timeline and actions in incident doc: /incidents/2867509999. Postmortem owner: ml_infra_jules. Please collect calibration artifacts, driver traces, and exact kernel versions.

ml_infra_jules: Will own postmortem. Early hypothesis: driver change + int8 calibrated kernels introduced a dequant/cast race for fused attention kernel under large KV cache; fix path: regenerate int8 kernels under new driver or gate int8 profile until validated.

product_emily: Flagging follow-up: - communicate mitigation to affected customers - update docs on auto-calib rollout gating and alert thresholds - consider multi-variant coldstart routing to avoid single-profile rollouts.

support_raj: Noted. I'll prepare customer-safe summary and send to affected customers with ETA for root-cause postmortem.

eng_ops_leo: Action: create hotpatch job to prevent future auto-rollouts on driver changes: `guardrails add driver-change:prevent-calib-rollouts=true`

oncall_mai: Thanks team. If anything re-escalates ping this thread and @sre_oncall. I'll hand off to @sre_ash in 40m for night watch.

sre_ash: Acknowledged — will take watch and shepherd postmortem follow-ups. :thumbsup:
